def norm(pat):
    # pat: list of strings of '#'/'.'; trim to bbox, return canonical min over dih
    rs=[r for r,row in enumerate(pat) if '#' in row]
    cs=[c for c in range(len(pat[0])) if any(row[c]=='#' for row in pat)]
    if not rs: return None
    sub=[row[min(cs):max(cs)+1] for row in pat[min(rs):max(rs)+1]]
    def key(p):
        return '|'.join(p)
    g=[list(row) for row in sub]
    forms=set()
    cur=g
    for _ in range(4):
        forms.add(key([''.join(r) for r in cur])); forms.add(key([''.join(r[::-1]) for r in cur]))
        cur=[[''.join(r) for r in x] for x in zip(*cur[::-1])]
        cur=[list(r) for r in cur]
    return min(forms)
